note: Trust root for the CI/CD release pipeline (see .github/workflows/release.yml). Payload, seal and checkpoint hashes are already public in docs/release-ledger.md and docs/releases/v0.1.0.md; the vendor-tree and GPL-2 pins below are pipeline packaging values, independently recomputed and reviewed at introduction. The pipeline refuses to publish unless downloaded staging bytes match these pins exactly.
evidence_policy: Raw measurement evidence is never a release asset or staging input (ADR-0012). The pipeline refuses evidence-shaped staging files; releases publish exactly five assets.
vendor_tree_note: SHA-256 over the canonical 'sha256  relpath' listing (sorted by relpath, LF) of vendor/ plus LICENSES/dependencies/ as carried in the source archive.
gpl2_note: Exact bytes of packaging/release/GPL-2.txt (vendored; identical to Debian common-licenses GPL-2); the pipeline refuses to substitute any other license text.
